title: Another Word for Hot: Stop Saying "Very Hot" (10 Words)
description:
Another word for hot: stop saying "very hot" and use one of these 10 better English words instead. You get five words for hot weather and five words for hot food, hot water and fire. Every word comes with a picture, a clear meaning and an example sentence. After each set of five words, you test yourself with a quick quiz and practise speaking by repeating the example sentences out loud after me.

Chapters
0:00 Intro
0:10 Hot weather
1:04 Speaking practice: hot weather
1:34 Hot food, water and fire
2:28 Speaking practice: food, water and fire
2:56 Your turn

The 10 words
Hot weather: boiling, scorching, sweltering, baking, roasting
Hot food, water and fire: piping hot, steaming, scalding, red-hot, blazing

Which word will you use next time? Write it in the comments.

Find another word for any word on anotherwordfor.net

#englishvocabulary #learnenglish #synonyms
